sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Ophthalmology (CODE: OP) table read at text offsets 680000-780000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that restated rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level contains SH or is P; knowledge mode otherwise. One documented exception (OP4.9).
scope: All 59 Ophthalmology references in the index (OP1.1-OP10.7); none had selected review evidence at the checked head.
observations: Domain/level cells for OP4.8 (S/SH, describe) and OP4.9 (K/KH, demonstrate) look swapped; OP7.3 (describe) also reads S/SH. Recheck on the rendered page.
Topic 10 header lists one certifiable competency; OP10.1 shows 5 in its certification column.
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
Programme names not checked for currency.
The 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.

rows.note: Official row names hordeolum externum and internum; draft says styes.

Official cells read K/KH, but the row asks the learner to demonstrate corneal foreign body removal; the neighbouring OP4.8 (describe eye donation) reads S/SH, suggesting swapped cells. Practical draft mode accepted.
Official row is "describe" angle-closure glaucoma but its cells read S/SH; practical draft mode follows the level.
Official row names NPCB including Vision 2020; draft uses official material.
